title: LORD, LET YOUR POWER ACCOMPLISH WHAT MY STRENGTH CANNOT
text: Hallelujah. Hallelujah. We give you praise, Lord. We give you praise. Father, we acknowledge you this morning. We acknowledge you not as a distant deity, not as a theological concept that men debate in seminaries, but as the living God, the one who is present right now in this moment, breathing upon these words. Breathing upon every heart that is tuned in to receive. Holy Spirit, you are welcome here. You are welcome in this place. You are welcome in every room, every bus, every car, every kitchen where someone is listening to this word this morning. We receive you. We receive you. Now, settle your heart. Settle your heart because what God is about to do in the next moments will not [music] be ordinary. I want you to know that before we even begin, heaven has already marked this moment. Heaven has already marked you. And the reason you found this word, the reason your eyes are on this page, the reason your ears are inclined to hear is not by accident. The Holy Ghost is too intentional for accidents. He arranged this He arranged this for you. The title the Lord gave me carries a cry in it. It carries a sound that I believe is the sound of someone who has tried, someone who has fasted, someone who has prayed, someone who has confessed the word. Someone who has done everything they were taught to do, and yet they are standing before a mountain that has not moved. And from the depth of that experience, from that place of honest, holy desperation, they lift their hands and they say, "Lord, let your power accomplish what my strength cannot." There is something profoundly beautiful about a soul that has come to the end of itself. [music] Hear me, there is something that attracts the presence of God about a person who is no longer pretending they can handle it. Because as long as you believe your strength is sufficient, God in His mercy will allow you to try. But the moment you come to the end of yourself, and you open your hands and you say, "God, I cannot do this. Something shifts in the realm of the spirit. Something shifts. Let me take you to a scripture that I want to lay as the foundation of everything we are going to build this morning. Go with me to the book of Zechariah chapter 4 and verse 6. And I want you to read it not the way you have read it before. I want you to read it the way a drowning man reads a life jacket. Then he answered and speak unto me saying, "This is the word of the Lord unto Zerubbabel saying, not by might nor by power, but by my spirit said the Lord of hosts." Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit said the Lord of hosts. Now, this is important. This is important. The context of this passage is a man named Zerubbabel who has been tasked with rebuilding the temple. He has looked at the rubble. He has counted his resources. He has assessed his manpower. He has done the mathematics of his situation and the numbers do not add up. The task before him is greater than everything available to him. And God sends a prophet to him in that moment of paralysis and says, "Son, I want to recalibrate your understanding of how this is going to work. Not by might, not by power, but by my spirit." The word might in that text refers to physical collective strength. The kind [music] of strength an army possesses. The kind of strength that comes when men gather together and apply force. The word power refers to individual human ability, your personal competence, your skill, your intelligence, your influence, your resources. And God is saying to Zerubbabel, and God is saying to you this morning, "Neither the collective strength of your community, nor the individual power [music] of your personality will be what brings this to completion. It will be my spirit." I need you to understand something about the Holy Spirit this morning. I need you to understand that the spirit of God is not a supplement to your effort. He is not the thing you add when your effort runs out. He's not the emergency option that you call when plan A and plan B have failed. The Holy Spirit is the primary strategy of heaven for the life of every believer. He's the plan. He's not plan B. He's the plan. In the second chapter of Acts when the early church was waiting in the upper room, they were not waiting as people who had already tried everything and were now resorting to prayer. No. Jesus had specifically commanded them not to depart from Jerusalem until they had received the promise of the Father. Why? Because Jesus who had walked the earth for 3 years in unbroken [music] intimacy with the Father, Jesus who had healed the sick and raised the dead and walked on water, Jesus in his divine wisdom understood that even the works he had done were done through the agency of the Holy Spirit. And if those who would carry his name into all the earth were going to attempt that assignment without the same spirit, they were going to fail. So, he said, "Wait. Wait for the power." Acts 1 verse 8. But ye shall receive power after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you. And ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem and in all Judaea and in Samaria and unto the uttermost part of the earth. Hear me. The promise is power, not advice, not a roadmap, not a five-step strategy for church growth. Power, dunamis, the explosive, miraculous, mountain-moving, situation-transforming power of the living God deposited in a human life. I am preaching to somebody this morning. I am preaching to somebody whose situation has defied every natural solution. I am preaching to somebody who went to the doctors and the [music] doctors did their best and sent you home. I am preaching to somebody whose business plan was solid and yet the business is struggling. I am preaching to somebody whose marriage by every logical standard should be working and yet there is distance, there is coldness, there is something that human wisdom cannot diagnose. I am preaching to somebody who has prayed the prayers they knew how to pray and yet the heavens felt like brass. This word is for you. This word is for you. Because here is what God wants you to know. Your strength reaching its limit is not the end of your story. It is the beginning of the chapter where God shows up. Paul understood this. Paul who had more academic credentials than most of us in the room, who had sat at the feet of Gamaliel, who had memorized the Torah, who was advancing in Judaizing beyond his peers, when Paul encountered the living Christ on the road to Damascus, everything changed. Not because his intellect became irrelevant, but because [music] he discovered that there is a category of work in the kingdom of God that intellect alone cannot perform. Second Corinthians chapter 12. And he said unto me, "My grace is sufficient for thee, for my strength is made perfect in weakness." Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities that the [music] power of Christ may rest upon me. Paul is saying something extraordinary here. He is saying that the conditions under which the power of Christ manifests most powerfully in a life are the conditions of acknowledged weakness, not fake weakness, not perform humility, but genuine, transparent, honest acknowledgement that I have come to the end of what I can produce. This is why the posture of prayer is so significant. When you kneel, when you bow, when you lift your hands and turn your face to heaven, you are not just performing a religious ritual. You are making a physical declaration to the realm of the spirit that says, "I am not the source. I am not the [music] source of what I need. The source is above me and I am looking up." And something in the realm of the spirit responds to that posture of dependency. Let me talk to you about the nature of God's power for a moment because I think many believers have a diminished view of what God's power can actually do. We have been told that God can save souls. We believe that. We have been told that God can heal the sick. We accept that. But somewhere between Sunday morning and Monday morning, we begin to live as though God's power is limited to the spiritual and does [music] not touch the practical, and that is a lie. That is a deception that has robbed entire generations of believers of the fullness what Christ purchased on the cross. Romans chapter 1:16. For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ, [music] for it is the power of God unto salvation to everyone that believeth. The word salvation in that text is the Greek word sozo. And sozo does not only mean the forgiveness of sins, though it certainly includes that. Sozo means to be made whole, to be preserved, to be kept safe, to be rescued, to be healed, to be delivered. To be restored. The power of God unto sozo to everyone that believeth. Hear me now. God's power is authorized to touch your health. It is authorized to touch your finances. It is authorized to touch your family. It is authorized to touch your mind. Because some of us are fighting battles in the mind that no medication has been able to fully resolve, and the spirit of God has authority over every stronghold in the human mind. It is authorized to touch your destiny. Every area of your life is a legitimate territory for the power of God to manifest. But there is a condition. There is a condition, and I need to spend time here because this is where many people miss it. The condition is not perfection. The condition is not having the right denominational membership. The condition is not having fasted for 40 days. The condition, according to Romans 1:16, is belief. To everyone that believe it, faith. Active, engaged, functioning faith that says, "God, I may not understand the how, but I am convinced about the who. And the who is you, Lord. And if it is you, then it is enough. If it is you, then I have everything I need." Now, I want to pause here. I want to pause here because the Holy Spirit is pressing on my [music] heart to pray. This is what happens in genuine ministry. You don't always follow your notes. The spirit of God begins to move, and you have to move with him. And right now, he's pressing on my heart to pray with you, to pray for you, to pray over the specific situations that you brought into this moment. Father, we come before your throne this morning. We come not based on our merit, not based on our performance, not based on our track record, but we come based on the blood of your son, Jesus Christ, that has opened the way into your very presence. The veil is torn, Father. The veil is torn, and we run into your presence with boldness, with confidence. Not arrogance, but the confidence that comes from being loved by you. We come, Father. And I want to lift before you every person engaging with this word right now. Every person whose strength has failed them. Every person who has been carrying a weight that was too heavy for human shoulders. Every person who has cried in the night and wondered, "God, do you see me? God, can you hear me?" Father, let your answer to that question be felt right now. Not just heard with the ears, but felt in the spirit. Let every broken heart feel the nearness of your presence this morning. I pray for health, Lord. Bodies that have been attacked, organs that have been malfunctioning, diagnoses that came like a verdict. Father, I stand in the gap, and I declare that you are still the God who heals all our diseases. Psalm 103:3 Who forgiveth all thine iniquities, who healeth all thy diseases. Not some. Not the ones that medicine cannot explain. All. Father, let your healing power move right now. From the crown of the head to the soles of the feet, [music] let the life of God course through every body that is receiving this word. I pray for provision, Lord. Situations where the account is empty, where the month is longer than the money, where the business is bleeding, where the career has stalled, Father, you are Jehovah Jireh, the Lord who sees and the Lord who provides. And what you see in their situation, Lord, you are moved with compassion to address. Provide. Open doors that no man can shut. Connect them to the right people, the right opportunities, the right ideas. Let the economy of heaven invade their earthly circumstances. I pray for relationships, Lord. Marriages on the edge of breaking, children who have wandered from the faith, friendships that have been fractured, families divided by misunderstanding and offense. Father, you are the God of reconciliation. You reconciled us to yourself through Christ Jesus. Turn the hearts of fathers to children and children to fathers. Let healing come to every broken relationship that is being represented in this prayer this morning. And Lord, for the ones who are fighting battles in the mind, battles of anxiety, battles of depression, battles of fear that come in the night and make the future feel impossible, I declare the peace of God that passeth all understanding. Philippians 4:7. And the peace of God which passeth all understanding shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus. Keep. The word is keep. Guard. Protect. Like a military garrison around the city, let your peace guard every heart and every mind that is engaged with this word. In Jesus' name we pray. In Jesus' name we pray. Amen. Now, come back with me. Come back with me because I am not done teaching and I need you to stay with me because what I am about to share is going to unlock something for you. We were talking about the power of God and the condition of faith. And I want to take you one step further and talk about what I call the posture of surrender. Because there are people who believe in God's power but who have not yet arrived at the posture of surrender and surrender is the doorway through which God's power enters the situations of your life. Isaiah chapter 64 verse 8. >> [music] >> But now oh Lord thou art our father, we are the clay and thou our potter and we all are the work of thy hand. Clay in the hands of a potter. This is not a passive image. The potter is actively pressing, shaping, turning, sometimes applying what feels like uncomfortable pressure in order to bring the clay into the form he envisions. And the clay that resists the potter's hand cannot be shaped. But the clay that yields, the clay that remains soft, pliable, but willing to be formed, that clay becomes a vessel that the potter is satisfied with. I want to ask you a question this morning and I want you to answer it honestly in your own heart. Are you trying to tell God the shape you need to be? Are you coming to prayer with your plans already formed and simply asking God to bless what you have already decided? Or are you coming with open hands saying, "Father, I don't know the shape. I don't know the path. I don't know the method. I just know that you are the potter and I am the clay and I trust your hands." This is important. This is important because there is a difference between using God's power as a tool to accomplish your agenda and surrendering to God so that his power can accomplish his purposes in and through your life. The first posture keeps you at the center. The second posture puts God at the center. And the kingdom only functions when God is at the center. Think about Moses. Moses was a man of considerable human strength. He had been raised in Pharaoh's palace. He had received the finest education that Egypt could provide. He had seen an Israelite being beaten by an Egyptian taskmaster and in the strength of his own arm he killed the Egyptian and buried him in the sand. He thought he was helping. He thought he was using his strength to accomplish the liberation of his people and instead he found himself fleeing as a fugitive to the wilderness of Midian where he would spend 40 years doing something so far from palace life that it must have felt like an eternal demotion. Tending sheep in the wilderness. But here is what happened in that wilderness. The strength that Moses had been relying on, the confidence that came from palace training, the self-sufficiency that came from being the son of Pharaoh's daughter, all of it was being stripped away in 40 years of obscurity. And then one day a bush burns and is not consumed. And when Moses turns to see this extraordinary thing God speaks from the bush. And the mission that Moses had tried to accomplish through his own strength in the murder of one Egyptian, God is now about to accomplish through a surrendered vessel in the liberation of an entire nation. Do you understand what I'm saying? Your strength touched one Egyptian. God's power through a yielded Moses brought an entire nation out of 400 years of bondage. The multiplication factor between human strength and divine power is incalculable. It cannot be measured. When God gets involved, what you could never have produced in a thousand lifetimes of striving, he accomplishes in a moment. If you are hearing this word right now, I want you to pause whatever you are doing and share this with someone. Share it with someone who has been trying to carry something that is too heavy for human hands. Share it with someone who is on the verge of giving up. Because this word did not come to you accidentally and it was not meant to stop with you. Be a carrier of this message. Pass it on. Now, let me bring you into the prophetic. Let me bring you into the prophetic because there are things that the spirit of God wants to declare over you this morning that go beyond the teaching. The teaching is the foundation, the prophetic is the structure that goes up on the foundation. And I want you to open your spirit now. I want you to receive what the spirit of God is saying. I hear the Lord saying to someone this morning, the waiting season is not a punishment. It is a preparation. What you have interpreted as God's absence was actually God's intentional process. He has been in the furnace with you, the way he was in the furnace with Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. And what is being burned in that furnace is not you. It is the thing that has been holding you back. It is the rope that the enemy had used to limit your movement. And when you [music] come out, you will not smell like smoke. You will walk out free. I hear the Lord saying to someone whose business, whose project, whose ministry has been stagnant. The stagnation is breaking. This is not a hopeful declaration. This is a prophetic word. The stagnation is breaking. What was delayed is being released. The God who opened the Red Sea, the God who brought water out of a rock, the God who multiplied five loaves and two fishes to feed 5,000, that same God is turning his attention to your situation right now. And the supernatural is about to invade the natural. I hear the Lord saying to someone who has been fighting a health battle in secret. You have not told people because you do not want to be pitied. You have been carrying it alone. God sees you. And the word he sends to you this morning is the same word he sent through his son to the woman who had the issue of blood for 12 years. Your faith has made you whole. Receive it. Receive it right now. Let the healing power of God that flows from the finished work of the cross [music] move through your body. Receive your healing in Jesus' name. Now, I want to move into intercession. I want to move into militant, deliberate, targeted intercession because there are things that only shift through prayer. There are wars that only come down through intercession. And I want to lead you into a posture of warfare prayer right now because some of what you are facing is not merely circumstantial. It is not just a bad economy or bad luck or unfortunate timing. There is a spiritual dimension to the resistance you are encountering and it must be addressed in the spirit. Ephesians chapter 6 verse 12. For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places. The word wrestle is significant. It implies proximity. It implies engagement. [music] You cannot wrestle from a distance. You have to be close. And prayer is how you get close to the conflict and close to the victory. Prayer is not the preparation for the battle. Prayer is the battle. Now, pray with me. Open your mouth. Pray out loud. Do not let this be a passive receiving of words. Let your voice be a weapon in the spirit right now. Father, we stand in the name of Jesus. We stand on the authority of the name that is above every name. The name before which every knee shall bow, of things in heaven and things in earth and things under the earth. We come in that name. We come with the blood of Jesus as our covering. We come with the word of God as our sword and we're declaring this morning over every life represented in this prayer that the power of God is greater than the power of the enemy. We renounce fear. We renounce it by [music] name. Spirit of fear, you have no legal right in the life of any son or daughter of God. For God has not given us the spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind. Second Timothy 1:7. We receive power. We receive love, we receive the sound mind that God has provided through Christ Jesus. Every imagination that has been exalting itself above the knowledge of God in someone's mind, we cast it down right now. We cast it down in Jesus' name. We pull down every stronghold of lack, every generational pattern of poverty that has followed a bloodline, we sever it in the name of Jesus. Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us. For it is written, cursed is everyone that hangeth on a tree. Galatians 3:13. The curse is broken. The cycle is broken. What your father could not achieve and your grandfather could not achieve does not have a mandate to be the ceiling of your generation. You are a new creation. All things are passed away. The old patterns, the old cycles, the old limitations are passed away. All things have become new. We intercede for marriages. We come against the spirit of division, the spirit of adultery, the spirit of coldness and indifference that has been assigned to destroy homes. Father, let the love of God be shed abroad in the hearts of couples who are struggling this morning. What God has joined together, let no man, let no devil, let no circumstance put asunder. We pray for supernatural restoration, supernatural rekindling, supernatural grace for forgiveness between husband and wife. Let [music] homes be healed in Jesus' name. Let homes be healed. We pray for children, for young people who have strayed from the path, who are in environments and with associations that are dangerous to their destiny. Father, the same way you brought the prodigal son to himself and turned his feet back toward home, bring every prodigal son and daughter back. Create in them a holy dissatisfaction with everything that is not [music] your will. Give them a hunger for the father's house. Bring them back. Bring them back in Jesus' name. We pray for those who are in prisons, literal and spiritual. Those who are incarcerated by a system, those who are incarcerated by an addiction, those who are incarcerated by a mindset that has told them they can never be more than what they are. Father, let the gates of brass be broken and the bars of iron be cut in sunder. Isaiah 45:2. You are a God who goes before us and makes the crooked places straight. Go before your people this morning. Break down the gates, cut down the bars, set the captives free. And Father, we pray for breakthrough in the area of purpose. So many people are alive but not living. They are existing but not thriving. They are going through motions but they have lost connection to the reason they were created. Father, reconnect them to purpose. Let the gifts and callings that you placed in them before they were born begin to stir again. For the gifts and callings of God are without [music] repentance. They have not expired, they have not been revoked. Father, let them arise, let them awaken, let them function the way you designed them to function. Let every believer walk in the fullness of their God-given assignment in Jesus' name. We decree and declare that the power of God is at work in every situation represented in this prayer. We decree that what man has declared impossible, God is making possible. We decree that what the enemy has called finished, God is saying is just beginning. We decree open doors, we decree divine connections, we decree supernatural provision, supernatural healing, supernatural peace, supernatural wisdom for every decision that needs to be made. We decree that the latter glory of every life in this prayer shall be greater than the former, the former rain and the latter rain in the same season. Everything that was lost, every year that the canker worm ate, every season that the enemy stole, the Lord is restoring. He is restoring it now. He's restoring it now in Jesus mighty name. In Jesus mighty name. Amen. Come back now. Come back into the teaching place one final time because I want to close with a charge. I want to close by putting something in your spirit that you will carry with you. Not just for today, but for every day. When your strength threatens to [music] give out and the temptation is to believe that what God cannot be reached in [music] this particular valley. Psalm 46 verse one. God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. A very present help. Not a distant consultant. Not a God who sees your situation and makes a note to come and assist you at his next available opportunity. A very present help. Present. Now. In this moment, in this situation. In this specific peculiar, confusing, painful, complicated situation that you are facing, he is very present. And I want you to hold on to that as we close. I want you to hold on to the reality that the same God who breathed life into the first man from the dust of the ground, the same God who held back the waters of the Red Sea with the east wind, the same God who shut the mouths of lions in a den, the same God who raised Jesus from among the dead on the third morning, that God is your God. He is not a museum piece. He is not a relic from a previous dispensation who has retired from active supernatural work. He is alive. He is active. He is attentive. And he is for you. Your weakness is not a disqualification. It is an invitation. It is an invitation for the power that has no ceiling, the power that has no limit, the power that defies every category of human understanding to come and do what only God can do. And when he does it, no man will be able to take the credit. No circumstance will be able to explain it. No enemy will be able to deny it. Because the thing that happens when God moves cannot be explained by natural means. It can only be attributed to him. So, I charge you, do not give up. I charge you, do not stop praying. I charge you, do not allow the silence of a season to convince you that God has abandoned you. He has not. [music] He cannot. For he himself has said, "I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee, so that we may boldly say, 'The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.'" Hebrews 13, verses 5 and 6. He's your helper. He's your very present help. And the power that you cannot manufacture in yourself, the breakthrough that you cannot engineer through your own strategies, the healing that no human hand can produce, the restoration that seems humanly impossible, the open door in the face of what looks like a permanent wall, the provision in the middle of the desert, the miracle in the middle of the mess, all of it. All of it is available because of who he is and because of what Christ has done. Lord, let your power accomplish what my strength cannot. That is not a defeated cry. That is a faith declaration. That is you positioning yourself in the posture of dependency that releases the fullness of heaven into your earthly situation. Say it again in your spirit. Say it like you mean it. Lord, let your power accomplish what my strength cannot, and watch what he will do. Watch what he will do. Watch what he will do. The Lord bless you. The Lord keep you. The Lord make his face to shine upon you and be gracious unto you. The Lord lift up his countenance upon you and give you peace. Go in the power of the spirit. Go expecting. Go anticipating. And do not be surprised when the miracle happens because you prayed for it, you believed it, and God [music] is faithful.
